_readme: Claude Code settings for the multimodal-ai-stack.
Routes all Claude Code traffic through the local LiteLLM proxy (port 4000).
LiteLLM handles model routing, fallbacks, cost tracking, and Langfuse
observability automatically — no Claude Code-side plugin is needed.
- Replace ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value below with your LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
Use /model inside Claude Code to switch between routing groups.
set the default model for the main and background-task roles respectively.
All routing, fallbacks, and cost tracking are handled by LiteLLM.
Completions are traced to Langfuse (http://localhost:3000) automatically
via LiteLLM's success_callback — no extra Claude Code configuration needed.
smart            - Qwen3-14B -> Ollama -> Gemini Flash -> Gemini Pro
build            - Qwen3-14B (40k ctx limit) -> Claude Sonnet 4.6
